decisions.reason: As a newly launched and publicly presented product, the electronic church-motif music box is likely to be given more time, even though it is somewhat less central to the firm's core woodcraft line.
The wooden nativity stable fits the firm's core woodworking and seasonal decorative business, so prior investment and visible commitment make an early withdrawal unlikely.
The modern incense smoker figurine remains close to established German wooden giftware, and without clear evidence of failure management would likely continue it rather than reverse course quickly.
